financings_after_balance_sheet.what: At-the-market offering sales of 1,016,950 shares from Jan 1 through Mar 20, 2024 (gross proceeds; net not given)
financings_after_balance_sheet.quote: The Company sold 1,016,950 shares of its common stock under its Sales Agreement for its at-the-market offering program subsequent to December 31, 2023 through March 20, 2024 for aggregate gross cash proceeds of $15.0 million
